patches_modified.name: App refresh rate
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the app refresh rate.

patches_modified.name: Bypass certificate checks
patches_modified.description: Bypasses certificate checks which prevent YouTube Music from working on Android Auto.

patches_modified.name: Change header
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the header logo in the top left corner of the app.

patches_modified.name: Change miniplayer color
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the miniplayer background color to match the fullscreen player.

patches_modified.name: Change start page
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to set which page the app opens in instead of the homepage.

patches_modified.name: Check watch history domain name resolution
patches_modified.description: Checks if the device DNS server is preventing user watch history from being saved.

patches_modified.name: Crossfade
patches_modified.description: Adds a true dual-player crossfade between consecutive tracks. Requires YouTube Music 9.00 or newer; on older versions the patch is a no-op.

patches_modified.name: Custom branding
patches_modified.description: Adds options to change the app icon and app name. Branding cannot be changed for mounted (root) installations.

patches_modified.name: Disable DRC audio
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable DRC (Dynamic Range Compression) audio.

patches_modified.name: Disable QUIC protocol
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable QUIC (Quick UDP Internet Connections) network protocol.

patches_modified.name: Disable dislike redirection
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to prevent skipping to the next track when the dislike button is pressed.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds support to download songs with an external downloader app using the in-app download button.

patches_modified.name: Enable debugging
patches_modified.description: Adds options for debugging and exporting Morphe logs to the clipboard.

patches_modified.name: Enable exclusive audio playback
patches_modified.description: Enables the option to play audio without video.

patches_modified.name: Enable forced miniplayer
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to enable forced miniplayer when switching between music videos, podcasts, or songs.

patches_modified.name: Enable swipe to dismiss miniplayer
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to enable dismissing the miniplayer by swiping down on it.

patches_modified.name: Force original audio
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always use the original audio track.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Allows the app to work without root by using a different package name when patched using a GmsCore instead of Google Play Services.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide fullscreen ads, Premium promotions and video ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide the cast, history, notification, and search buttons.

patches_modified.name: Hide filter bar
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the filter bar at the top of the homepage.

patches_modified.name: Hide flyout menu components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide individual items from the player and queue flyout menus.

patches_modified.name: Hide layout components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide general layout components.

patches_modified.name: Hide music action buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide action buttons under the player.

patches_modified.name: Miniplayer previous and next buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to show previous and next track buttons in the miniplayer.

patches_modified.name: Navigation bar
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide navigation bar, labels and buttons.

patches_modified.name: Network proxy
patches_modified.description: Adds settings to route supported network requests through an HTTP or HTTPS proxy.

patches_modified.name: Play albums songs
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to play the song version of album tracks instead of music videos.

patches_modified.name: PoToken provider
patches_modified.description: Adds option to get PoToken using an external PoToken minter app.

patches_modified.name: Remember repeat state
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remember the repeat state when playing a new track or playlist.

patches_modified.name: Remember shuffle state
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remember the shuffle state when playing a new track or playlist.

patches_modified.name: Remove background playback restrictions
patches_modified.description: Removes restrictions on background playback, including playing kids videos in the background.

patches_modified.name: Remove viewer discretion dialog
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remove the dialog that appears when opening a video that has been age-restricted by accepting it automatically. This does not bypass the age restriction.

patches_modified.name: Return YouTube Dislike
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the dislike count of tracks with Return YouTube Dislike.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.

patches_modified.name: Scrobbling
patches_modified.description: Adds options to add played tracks to Last.fm and ListenBrainz.

patches_modified.name: Settings menu filter
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide items on the standard YouTube Music settings screen by their visible name.

patches_modified.name: SponsorBlock
patches_modified.description: Adds options to enable and configure SponsorBlock, which can skip non-music segments.

patches_modified.name: Spoof app version
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to trick the app into thinking you are running an older version.

patches_modified.name: Spoof video streams
patches_modified.description: Adds options to spoof the client video streams to fix playback.

patches_modified.name: Theme
patches_modified.description: Adds options for theming, and settings to change the app foreground and background colors.

patches_modified.name: Third-party lyrics
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show synced lyrics from LRCLIB or KuGou in the lyrics panel.

patches_modified.name: Hide player overlay buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide the player Cast, Autoplay, Captions, Previous & Next buttons, and to hide or change the opacity of the player control buttons background.

patches_modified.name: Disable Kaspersky background scan
patches_modified.description: Disables periodic Kaspersky scheduling and reports disabled workers as successfully completed.

patches_modified.name: Disable advertisements
patches_modified.description: Removes ad providers, sanitizes ad identifiers, returns an empty ad list, and keeps advertising consent disabled.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics and trackers
patches_modified.description: Disables audited analytics transports and replaces the stable request device identifier.

patches_modified.name: Disable background hooks
patches_modified.description: Disables audited boot, network-state, VPN, and Connect session hooks.

patches_modified.name: Disable invasive permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes privileged install, location, storage, billing, USB, and vendor data access while preserving user-driven installs.

patches_modified.name: Disable push services
patches_modified.description: Disables RuStore and VK push initialization, services, and audited push receivers.

patches_modified.name: Disable verification hooks
patches_modified.description: Disables audited SMS, call, phone-state, SID, and Mail.ru verification hooks.

patches_modified.name: Exclude Google Play apps from update checks
patches_modified.description: Excludes only apps whose recorded Android installer is Google Play from update requests.

patches_modified.name: Hide gaming profile
patches_modified.description: Removes the gaming profile permission, hides both gaming buttons, and blocks navigation to the gaming profile.

patches_modified.name: Restore secure-session compatibility
patches_modified.description: Adapts secure-session requests to RuStore 1.108 API changes for re-signed APKs.

patches_modified.name: Restrict background work to updates
patches_modified.description: Keeps only the workers required for automatic updates and allows update checks to run while RuStore is foreground or background.

patches_modified.name: Skip update authentication
patches_modified.description: Skips the update authentication suggestion and returns a valid completed result.

patches_added.name: Appearance
patches_added.description: In-app appearance controls, adjustable from the Letterboxd Mods screen without re-patching: a true-black OLED surface, a custom accent colour (presets or any hex), and the bottom-navigation selected style. Applied at runtime via resource overlays on Android 12 and later. Needs the "Mod settings" patch.

patches_added.name: Mod settings
patches_added.description: HOW TO OPEN: long-press the settings gear on your profile tab. — This adds a "Letterboxd Mods" screen that collects the other patches' options (theme, accent, hide ratings, hide video store, etc.) so you can change them inside the app instead of re-patching. Some changes apply immediately, others after a restart, and you'll be prompted either way.

patches_modified.name: Denser poster grid
patches_modified.description: Tightens the spacing around posters in grids so they render larger and closer together. Does not change the number of columns.

patches_modified.name: Hide Video Store on home
patches_modified.description: Removes the "Letterboxd Video Store" promo row from the Films tab. The Video Store itself, its settings and every other entry point are left untouched. Can be toggled from the "Mod settings" screen if that patch is also enabled.

patches_modified.name: Hide ratings until watched
patches_modified.description: Hides the community rating (average + histogram) on a film's page until you have marked that film as watched, covering it with a tap-to-reveal control. The reveal is per visit — leave the film and come back and it is hidden again. Only the film page is affected; ratings shown in lists, search and elsewhere are unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Match bottom nav to top bar color
patches_modified.description: Paints Letterboxd's bottom navigation bar black (#000000), matching the top bar, instead of the default slate. Can be toggled from the "Mod settings" screen if that patch is also enabled; the change applies on the next app start. With "Material You theme" also on, this wins — turn it off to keep the Material You nav tint.

patches_modified.name: Material You theme
patches_modified.description: Repaints Letterboxd's dark chrome — window background, surfaces, cards, the top bar, tab strip, bottom nav and sheets — from the device's Material You palette on Android 12+ (no effect below). No accent or OLED options here; those live in the "Mod settings" screen. No effect on Jetpack Compose screens.
